title: Improper validation of consistency within input in AMD SEV (Secure Encrypted Virtualization) firmware could allow an…
description: CVE-2025-54507 is a vulnerability in AMD SEV firmware involving improper validation of input consistency. This flaw allows an attacker with administrative privileges to create multiple RMP entries for the same guest physical address, which could compromise guest integrity. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating and a CVSS score of 5.9. No known exploits or patches are currently documented.
